description:
Land PR #5 (opi-uuy: "Align session architecture with pi-mono") into the opi-fin branch so all extension framework rework happens in one place.

## Deliverable

Merge origin/opi-uuy into opi-fin. Resolve the single test conflict in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `git log opi-uuy..opi-fin --oneline` returns 0 lines (all opi-uuy commits present in opi-fin)
- [ ] `mix test` passes on the merged branch (zero failures across all apps)
- [ ] `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` clean
- [ ] No remaining merge markers (`grep -rn "<<<<<<<\|>>>>>>>" apps/` returns 0 matches)

## Notes

Branches are nearly orthogonal: 24 files in opi-uuy, 72 in opi-fin, 3 files overlap, 5 of 6 shared files auto-merge. Only conflict is in input_test.exs.
title: Merge opi-uuy into opi-fin
